authority.scope: nonthermal acquisition-linked weather/rainfall, geometry and comparison schedule; no empirical cooling/time inference

settings.hrrr: NOAA operational f00, AWS archive; sfc with prs fallback only if absent; TMP/DPT2m and U/V10m
settings.weather_timing: linear interpolation of cell-derived hourly frozen-domain summaries to exact acquisition including subseconds
settings.weather_spatial: grid-cell centers covered by make_valid frozen Census Urban Area; equal-cell means, as inherited HRRR archive
settings.vpd: cellwise FAO 0.6108/17.27/237.3, clip below zero, then domain mean; descriptive only
settings.rainfall_archive: Iowa State IEM mirror of NOAA operational MRMS
settings.rainfall_timing: 24/72/168 nonoverlapping complete hours ending floor(acquisition UTC); report subhour lag, never include future rain or interpolate accumulation
settings.rainfall_spatial: MRMS 0.01deg cell centers in frozen Census polygons, WGS84 geodesic cell-area weights; same cells every hour
settings.rainfall_missing: negative flags/bitmap missing are missing, never zero; incomplete hourly or spatial windows have no complete-domain total
settings.rainfall_fallback: NOAA Stage IV only after logged MRMS archive failure; never silently blend product values
settings.rainfall_exact_instant_total: not identified by hourly product; hour-ended totals are explicit descriptors
settings.geometry: verify cached nonthermal evidence/arrays for same orbit; separate full-domain coverage from modeled-cell coverage, no imputation
settings.time_model: no model fitted; inherited Phoenix June/August weights and two solar windows retained
settings.Atlanta: independent month/time inventory, no copied Phoenix weights
